about: City of Alton-Mississippi River drains about 36 square miles, 54% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 640 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 410 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Shields Branch and Brick House Slough. It includes part of West Alton. Downstream, its water passes through the City of Wood River-Mississippi River watershed on its way down the Mississippi River.
